claim_boundary: This package closes the evidence boundary that the archived comparator materials cannot be treated as equivalent to Ding's natural-graphite TTG/PBTE regime without a new explicit mapping. It does not close numeric Ding C_src, volumetric uncertainty, alpha_Phi_K, or Full Topic 13.
